description: Turns a short wish (for example 'a silver birch with lanterns') into a premium tree design. An AI paints the tree after the call (about 30 s); the first painting becomes the tree. Returns design_id and the tree genome. Max 3 designs per caller per day. Show the result to the user before you order.

wish.description: What the tree should look like, 1-200 characters. No brands, logos or text.

name: design_tree
title: Design a sponsored tree
